review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves a genuine population identification theorem, a sound-and-complete exact certificate, a deterministic perturbation guarantee, and an open-family refutation of the published rank selector on its full domain. The positive results nevertheless apply only after the unordered Gaussian component covariances have been identified or estimated, and the note supplies no sample-based component estimator or explicit finite-sample operator-error tail. Consequently, its stability theorem is conditional and does not establish an end-to-end statistical recovery guarantee from pooled observations; the exact-equality membership certificate is also not directly implementable with noisy empirical covariances. The framing accurately discloses these limitations, but the narrow fully covered observed-coordinate class and absence of reproducible finite-sample performance keep the projected leading-journal score below the strongest field-level papers. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

review.verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves population identification of the complete SEM explanation, sound-and-complete exact membership certification, and deterministic discrete stability on the observed-coordinate fully covered class, while its counterexamples and rank-only impossibility transfer negatively to the broader published class. It does not prove an estimator or operator-error tail for recovering the unordered Gaussian components from pooled samples, so the statistical problem ends at an oracle covariance interface and the causaldag application remains a semantic validation proposal rather than an operational workflow. The exact-equality, real-arithmetic certificate also supplies neither finite-precision acceptance guarantees nor approximate membership control. The framing consistently discloses these limits and does not present the open growing-mixture tail as established, but the narrow fully covered Gaussian scope and missing end-to-end statistical guarantee constrain significance at a leading econometrics journal. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
